label_protocol_a: POST_LIVE: protocol (a) runs after the live TRIM at rho = 10 deg already ran (Phase C5/C5b). Its results do not gate or re-score any live record; they close a material-level evidence gap only.
scope: Kinematic ideal-tracking material runs, 1 mm particles, 4 mm grid, 0.1 ms material dt, law 8, seed 42; provisional uncalibrated material; no robot, IK, grasp, slip or camera evidence

native_packed.scope: Native packed checks on the recorded packed codes (packed stencil graph, slot overflow, digits 0-3 never nonzero in any history frame or label record, armed steps report cut_index 4). The row criteria are then computed by the unchanged v4 analysis code of the counterpart row on an exact single-digit view: codes -> digit 4 value (0/1/2), stroke 5 -> 1, cut_index 4 -> 0. The view is exact only when no other digit is ever nonzero, which is itself a check; the packed-graph component count must equal the view's ternary component count (check).
